notes.title: APRIL FOOL’S UPDATE 0.2.2
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

With this update, we want to outline the future direction for KLETKA. In the next major update, we plan to add more interactions on the floors, enchantments for tools, weapons, and enemies, a reworked sentence and leveling system — and something else as well... We've upgraded the game to a new engine version, so outdated mods may no longer work. Also — we’ve added a new April Fools' mode — Turbostruct, featuring increased loot and enemy spawns, faster characters, and only 60 floors. If it proves popular, we might make it permanent :)

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The game has been upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.5.
[*] Added a new game mode: Turbostruct. This mode features 60 floors, more loot and enemies, and increased stats for the player, elevator, and enemies.
[*] Introduced a system of item and enemy enchantments. For now, enchanted entities can appear on any floor. In future updates, we plan to expand this system with crafting, new types of enchantments, and abilities.
[*] Item description windows have been reworked. Now you can view basic item info even when interaction isn't possible (e.g. full inventory).
[*] Damage values have been adjusted for some weapon types.
[*] Added a new anomalous floor: The Big Room.
[*] Added another anomalous floor: The Pool.
[*] Added notes to the floors.
[*] Added a new track by Eskimo.
[*] Added 3 new tracks by crystal lotus.
[*] Added a new track by houp.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed item stacking behavior.
[*] The Sentence Reroll Monument now grants an extra effect if the prisoner has fewer than 3.
[*] The Sentence Reroll Monument no longer grants duplicate effects.
[*] Glooper now releases the player after some time.
[*] Fire can no longer be extinguished with a flamethrower :0
[*] Fixed an equipment bug: some items would stop activating on LMB/RMB after pickup.
[*] Fixed spawn points for meat growths in the Fleshmine biome: they no longer block loot spawn points.
[/list]

notes.title: FLESHMINE UPDATE 0.2.0
notes.content:
Hello friends! Welcome to KLETKA's first major update! 

The [i][b]Fleshmine[/b][/i] is a vital part of the Gigastructure, where miners carve living flesh from the walls in the eternal twilight. Deep within the belly of this colossal structure, they mine flesh ore - the raw material for food concentrate, fuel, and other essential elements of daily life within the monolithic structure. But every coin has a flip side. 

In a cruel twist of fate, the rock whispered to the miners, and those who listened to its breath were swept into the dark abyss. The flesh plague struck without warning, twisting bodies into writhing, unrecognizable forms. Their minds consumed by insatiable hunger, the sound of pickaxes striking ore faded from these floors. Now, phantom silence lurks in restless anticipation of new visitors. 

Do you have the courage to venture into the horror-filled tunnels and avoid becoming part of their gruesome feast?

[previewyoutube=Rgv1zg7mcMA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[h2]Floors[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new biome: Fleshmine. Along with new rooms and unique floors, you'll also find never-before-seen items and encounter dangerous enemies.
[*] Added a new floor curse: Mist.
